events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in Bethel, New York, from August 15-18, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Imagine being at Woodstock in '69! What's the one performance you wish you'd seen live?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock 'n' Roll
angles.copy: 49 years since we lost The King. Elvis Presley's music still moves generations. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and later died on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur. His words and music continue to resonate decades later.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Celebrating the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His influence on guitar playing is simply legendary.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Crossing
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album, with that legendary cover, still sounds as fresh today. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon, still commanding the stage with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Mad for It
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that unmistakable swagger to British music.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic single 'Imagine' in the US on October 11, 1971.

angles.name: A World of Peace
angles.copy: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' continues to inspire. What does a world of peace look like to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped? It completely changed how we listen to music. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and which theme tune gets you in the 007 mood?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, the legendary comedian and actor, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, 'The Beatles' (known as the 'White Album'), on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The White Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' was released this week. A double album packed with incredible tracks – what's your favourite from it?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
